The '''second stage''' of the '''[[2014 Copa Libertadores|2014 Copa Libertadores de América]]''' was played from February 11 to April 10, 2014. A total of 32 teams competed in the second stage.<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento_copa_bridgestone_libertadores_2014_1.pdf|title=Copa Bridgestone Libertadores 2014 – Reglamento|language=Spanish|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
The draw of the tournament was held on December 12, 2013, 21:00 [[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]], at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/content/la-bridgestone-libertadores-tiene-calendario-establecido|title=La Bridgestone Libertadores tiene calendario establecido|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=December 12, 2013|language=Spanish}}</ref>

For the second stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups of four containing one team from each of the four seeding pots. The seeding of each team was determined by their association and qualifying berth (as per the rotational agreement established by CONMEBOL, the teams which qualified through berths 1 from Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Venezuela were seeded into Pot 1 for odd-numbered years, while the teams which qualified through berths 1 from Bolivia, Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay were seeded into Pot 1 for even-numbered years).<ref name="regulations"/> Teams from the same association in Pots 1 and 2 could not be drawn into the same group. However, a first stage winner, whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, could be drawn into the same group with another team from the same association.

==Seeding==
The following were the seeding of the 32 teams entered into the second stage draw, which included the 26 automatic qualifiers and the 6 [[2014 Copa Libertadores first stage|first stage]] winners:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/CBrLibertadores/status/411281166344257536/photo/1|title=Bolilleros 1 y 2 de la fase de grupos de la #CopaLibertadores 2014.|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=December 12, 2013|language=Spanish}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/CBrLibertadores/status/411282009273544704/photo/1|title=Bolilleros 3 y 4 de la fase de grupos de la #CopaLibertadores 2014.|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=December 12, 2013|language=Spanish}}</ref>

The first stage winners were:
*Winner G1: {{flagicon|BRA}} [[Clube Atlético Paranaense|Atlético Paranaense]]
*Winner G2: {{flagicon|BRA}} [[Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas|Botafogo]]
*Winner G3: {{flagicon|CHI}} [[Club Universidad de Chile|Universidad de Chile]]
*Winner G4: {{flagicon|ARG}} [[Club Atlético Lanús|Lanús]]
*Winner G5: {{flagicon|COL}} [[Independiente Santa Fe|Santa Fe]]
*Winner G6: {{flagicon|URU}} [[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]]

==Format==
In the second stage, each group was played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. Each team earned [[Three points for a win|3 points for a win]], 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss. If tied on points, the following criteria were used to determine the ranking: 1. [[Goal difference]]; 2. Goals scored; 3. Away goals scored; 4. Drawing of lots. The winners and runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2014 Copa Libertadores knockout stages|round of 16]].<ref name="regulations"/>

==Groups==
The matches were played on February 11–13, 18–20, 25–27, March 11–13, 18–20, 25–27, April 1–3, and 8–10, 2014.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/content/el-calendario-definido-de-la-copa-bridgestone|title=El calendario definido de la Copa Bridgestone|language=Spanish|date=December 25, 2013|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>
